text:
elaine: Quick sync — need final decisions for the GA readiness playbook by EOD. Top items: SLA tiers, docs checklist, oncall coverage, pricing guardrails, monitoring alerts. Who can own each?

mohit: I can take SLA tiers and SLO targets. Proposal: 99.9% p99 latency target for the Hosted tier, 99.95% for Dedicated. Will draft a short rationale.

sam-docs: I’ll own docs checklist. Can someone confirm minimum sections we must have: Quickstart, API changes, SDK examples, Rollback steps, Troubleshooting (latency/caching)?

lisa-finance: Pricing guardrails I'm on. Need to confirm cost per 1M tokens baseline and a burst-cap policy. Also want clear wording for reserved capacity discounts.

jordan-oncall: Oncall coverage: current plan is 24/7 for Severity 1, weekday daytime for S2. Need clarity on escalation path and who is primary for Dedicated incidents.

neha-legal: Quick flag — any customer-facing SLA that mentions credits needs a legal-approved template. I can fast-track review if we keep the wording tight.

mohit: For Dedicated incident ownership, suggest: primary = customer-eng lead (1st 30m), fallback = infra oncall, auto-failover to Hosted-compatible variant. Will put in rollout doc.

sam-docs: Checklist draft — adding minimal content list:
```
- What’s included in GA (endpoints/features)
- Config defaults and recommended limits
- SLA summary (linked to legal template)
- Runbook snippets for common failures
- How to opt into Dedicated / Private
```

elaine: Nice. For monitoring: we need 4 alert classes — latency regression, error spike, capacity fill, billing anomaly. Who can own alert thresholds?

mohit: Eng-runtime will own latency/error thresholds. I’ll add a staging-to-prod baseline and an automated alert suppression window for rollout.

jordan-oncall: Add a runbook link to each alert and include a simulated playbook we can rehearse in staging. :white_check_mark:

lisa-finance: Billing anomaly alerts: send to finance + product + infra. Alerts should include estimated $/hr burn delta.

neha-legal: Fine with that. Also flag privacy-sensitive monitoring — ensure logs redact customer content.

sam-docs: I’ll include a short "what to do on first alert" snippet in the docs.

elaine: Owners so far — SLA: mohIt; Docs: sam-docs; Pricing: lisa-finance; Oncall: jordan-oncall; Legal sign-off: neha-legal; Monitoring hooks: mohIt + jordan-oncall. If everyone agrees we’ll lock and publish the playbook draft by 18:00.

mohit: Agree. I’ll upload SLA draft to the drive and link in this thread.

lisa-finance: Agree, will provide pricing ranges.

jordan-oncall: Agree, will prepare basic escalation matrix.

sam-docs: Agree. I’ll start a doc PR and tag reviewers.

neha-legal: I’ll review SLA credits template once it's in the drive.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ga-readiness-playbook-draft -> staging at 2024-06-07T17:00Z :rocket:

elaine: Thanks all — if no objections by 16:30 I'll mark owners final and create the playbook PR. :thumbsup:
